_about: Curated list of organizations known to publish a valid `xrp-ledger.toml` at their domain. The toml is the cryptographic-grade proof: the org publishes the file at a domain they control, and anyone can fetch + verify. New orgs only get added here after manual confirmation that the file exists, parses, and contains an [[ACCOUNTS]] section listing real XRPL addresses.

ripple.com._note: Ripple's first-party toml. Source of the 20 monthly escrow wallets and the RLUSD issuer.

reaper.financial._note: Reaper Financial — DeFi issuer running two tickers (RPR + ASC) off r3qWgpz2ry3BhcRJ8JE6rxM8esrfhuKp4R. Uses [[TOKENS]] section, no [[ACCOUNTS]] block.

_known_failures.sologenic.com: Domain field set on SOLO issuer, but the toml URL returns HTML (no actual toml file). Manual SOLO entry stands.
_known_failures.xrplf.org: Redirects to xrpl.org HTML page; no toml.
_known_failures.foundation.xrpl.org: Redirects to xrpl.org HTML page; no toml.
